payload.instructions:
Role: senior software architekt/implementátor. Master pravidla: nepoužívat externí soubory; výstup vždy pouze validní JSON (bez markdownu/komentářů).

Další krok musí vrátit kontrakt A1_PLAN se strukturou: project{name,one_liner,target_os,language,runtime}, assumptions[], requirements{functional[],non_functional[],constraints[]}, architecture{modules[{name,responsibility,exports,dependencies}],data_flow[],error_handling[],security_notes[]}, build_run{prerequisites[],commands[],verification[]}, deliverable_policy{file_generation_strategy:"PLAN->STRUCTURE->FILE_CONTENT",max_lines_per_chunk:500}.

Rozšíření Windows UI app „Kája“ (OpenAI Responses API automation; robustní UI, detailní logování, pricing, A/B/QA/C pipeline, IN/OUT/DIAGNOSTICS; vector store + file_search jen pokud podporováno) o:

28.x SSH diagnostics (Ubuntu web server):
- Podpora PowerShell SSH one-liner varianty s heslem v příkazu (méně bezpečné); remote vyžaduje sshpass; použít sshpass -p $pw pro ssh i scp; StrictHostKeyChecking=no.
- Na remote běží bash skript sbírající diagnostiku do $remote_root (Diag_... struktura). Vždy mkdir -p; veškerý stdout+stderr zapisovat do souborů; chybějící subsystémy explicitně označit "NOT PRESENT". Nikdy nesbírat/ukládat secrets.
- Remote složky+artefakty (vše logovat):
  - firewall/: nft_ruleset.txt
  - users_permissions/: users_groups.txt, sudoers_listing.txt, umask.txt
  - processes_services/: process_list.txt, services_state.txt, startup_items.txt
  - packages/: dpkg_list.txt, apt_policy_key_pkgs.txt (nginx/openssl/python3/certbot/postgresql/redis), snap_list.txt
  - web/: web_root_overview.txt, static_assets_sizes.csv, web_server_headers_hint.txt (curl -I http://127.0.0.1 tolerantně, např. || true)
  - nginx/: nginx_version.txt, nginx_test.txt, nginx_conf_tree.txt
  - app/: app_dirs_overview.txt, systemd_units_related.txt (grep gunicorn/uvicorn/celery/worker), app_env_files_found.txt (jen listing/metadata; žádné secrets)
  - python/: where_python.txt, py_launcher_list.txt (pip versions), interpreters_inventory.csv (python3 sys.executable + sys.path jako JSON)
  - database/: postgres_version.txt, postgres_service_status.txt, postgres_conf_locations.txt
  - certs/: cert_locations.txt (find *.pem/*.crt), certbot_status.txt, cert_expiry_report.txt (openssl x509 -enddate pro /etc/letsencrypt/live/*/cert.pem)
  - cron_webhooks/: crontab_root.txt, crontab_users_listing.txt, system_cron_dirs_tree.txt
  - logs/: journal_nginx_last500.txt, journal_app_last500.txt, journal_db_last500.txt, syslog_tail.txt, auth_log_tail.txt, kernel_log_tail.txt
  - virtualization_containers/: docker_info.txt, docker_ps.txt, docker_compose_files_found.txt
- Na konci remote skript vypíše "REMOTE_ROOT=$remote_root"; PowerShell parsuje Select-String '^REMOTE_ROOT=' a stáhne celý adresář přes scp -r.
- MANIFEST/README doplnění (Ubuntu): folder list musí zahrnout nginx/, app/, python/, database/, certs/, cron_webhooks/, logs/, virtualization_containers/. README/MANIFEST obsahuje „File Index“ tabulku s příklady (README_problem.md, system/journal_boot_errors.txt, network/ss_listen.txt, nginx/nginx_test.txt, python/venv_candidates_found.txt, python/venv_reports/venv_*__report.json, certs/cert_expiry_report.txt, logs/journal_nginx_last500.txt, logs/journal_app_last500.txt). Notes: před sdílením redigovat secrets; logy mohou obsahovat PII → selektivní sdílení. Integrity: Total files {{file_count}}, Total size {{total_size_human}}, volitelně checksums/sha256.txt.
- Šablona 28.23 MANIFEST.md („Diagnostic Manifest“): timestamp_local, hostname, collector_user, is_root, os_pretty_name, kernel, uptime, output_root; Purpose: Ubuntu web server diagnostic snapshot; Folder Overview min.: system/, hardware/, storage/, network/, firewall/, users_permissions/, processes_services/, packages/, web/.
- Artefakty uploadnout do Files API, evidovat v manifestech; volitelně přidat do vector store s attributes source=diagnostics/scope/captured_at.

29) FULL Windows Diagnostics (konečný návrh; výstup adresář se soubory, ne ZIP):
- Cíle: úplná rekonstrukce systému bez archivace; oddělit defaultní vs runtime hodnoty; rozebrat více instalací Pythonu a všechny venv; transparentně analyzovat PATH, registry, aliasy a asociace.
- Kořen: Diag_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS/{MANIFEST.md, README_problem.md, CHANGELOG_last_actions.txt, system/, registry/, filesystem/, hardware/, storage/, drivers/, processes_services/, network/, security/, python/, devtools/, virtualization/, wsl/, logs/}.
- MANIFEST.md (auto): Generated at, Machine, User, PowerShell ver, Run as Administrator; Folder Overview; Files tabulka (File/Description/Size); Notes: ACCESS DENIED = vyžaduje admin; chybějící subsystémy explicitně.
- system/: systeminfo.txt, os_build.txt, windows_updates_hotfixes.txt, timezone_locale.txt, uptime_boot.txt, power_settings.txt, group_policy_summary.html, run_context.txt; env/PATH: env_machine.txt (HKLM parsed), env_user.txt (HKCU), path_effective_process.txt (runtime PATH), path_diff_analysis.txt (diff Machine vs User vs Runtime).
- registry/: env_machine.reg (HKLM ...\Environment), env_user.reg (HKCU\Environment); Python registry: python_core_hklm.reg, python_core_hklm_wow6432.reg, python_core_hkcu.reg, pylauncher_hklm.reg, pylauncher_hkcu.reg; App Execution: app_paths_python_hklm.reg, app_paths_python_hkcu.reg, windowsapps_execution_aliases.txt; Asociace: file_associations_python.reg; Software: uninstall_inventory.txt (Python/Conda/VC++ runtimes).
- filesystem/: python_executables_found.txt, python_install_dirs_tree.txt; venv: venv_candidates_found.txt, venv_tree_summaries/venv_<name>.txt; projekty: project_requirements_found.txt; uživatelská data (bez binárního obsahu, jen strom/velikosti): userprofile_tree_depth3.txt, userprofile_top_sizes.csv, appda
...
to-fit tak, aby se vešel (bez limitů); (4) znovu přeměř; pokud stále overflow (framework limit/rounding), povol overlay scrollbar pouze na ose overflow; (5) scroll se nesmí aktivovat preventivně.
- 6.7 Scrollbar (posuvný válec): overlay (neubírá místo). Vzhled: track černý, track okraj bílý, thumb bílý, šířka max(6, round(0.8×FS)). Pokud overlay scrollbar nejde, povolena výjimka (standardní scrollbar), ale barvy musí odpovídat paletě.
- 6.8 Dropdown (needitovatelný): pole = needitovatelný box dle nečerveného kontraktu (5) + vpravo šipka dolů (ikona A.1) barvy dle stavu. Roletka: otevře se dolů jako overlay; zobrazuje 5 položek; více = overlay scrollbar; pozadí černé, okraj bílý, oddělovače řádků bílá linka 1px; text položek bílý Regular. Hover uvnitř roletky: řádek invertuje (bílá plocha, černý text) pouze v roletce. Klávesnice: ŠIPKA DOLŮ otevře roletku a posouvá výběr; MEZERNÍK potvrdí položku a zavře; ESC zavře bez změny. Tooltip na položce: po 2 s nečinnosti jen při overflow (u kurzoru).
- 6.9 Combobox (editovatelný): textové pole (6.5) + roletka + šipka dolů vpravo. Filtrování: během psaní se roletka otevře a filtruje položky deterministicky podle case-insensitive prefix match; diakritika se porovnává přesně. Klávesnice: ŠIPKA DOLŮ otevře roletku a posouvá; ENTER vloží aktuální položku (je-li roletka otevřená) a zavře; MEZERNÍK v editaci vkládá mezeru (pokud roletka není v režimu výběru); ESC zavře roletku. Tooltip na položce: po 2 s nečinnosti jen při overflow.

PŘÍLOHA A – IKONY: všechny SVG viewBox="0 0 24 24", stroke-width=STROKE, stroke-linecap="round", stroke-linejoin="round", barvu určuje komponenta dle stavu. A.1 Šipka dolů: path "M6 9 L12 15 L18 9". A.2 CLOSE (X): path "M7 7 L17 17" a "M17 7 L7 17". A.3 Kalendář: rect x=5 y=6 w=14 h=14 rx=2 ry=2; path "M5 10 H19", "M8 4 V8", "M16 4 V8"; text DD.MM.YYYY není součást SVG. A.4 INFO (volitelně): path "M12 10 V17" a "M12 7 H12.01".

PŘÍLOHA B – PÍSMO (Montserrat) – distribuce: přibalit Montserrat-Regular a Montserrat-Bold (TTF/OTF); při startu zaregistrovat a použít pro celé UI; zakázat fallback; při selhání registrace → chybový dialog + ukončení; pinovat soubory a kontrolovat hash v build pipeline.

PŘÍLOHA C – KONTROLA SHODY (automatické testy): golden screenshots (hlavní obrazovky + dialog + tabulka + dropdown + combobox) ve 3 velikostech okna (např. 800×600, 1280×720, 1920×1080); kontrola hash fontů v CI; statická kontrola tokenů (barvy, tloušťky, radius, paddingy).

{
  "contract": "A1_PLAN",
  "project": {
    "name": "Kája",
    "one_liner": "Windows UI app for OpenAI Responses API automation with robust diagnostics capture (Ubuntu SSH + FULL Windows), logging, pricing, and artifact upload/indexing.",
    "target_os": "Windows 10/11 (client app) + Ubuntu Server (remote diagnostics target via SSH)",
    "language": "C#",
    "runtime": ".NET 8 (Windows Desktop)"
  },
  "assumptions": [
    "Existing Kája codebase already implements: OpenAI Responses API automation, Files API uploads, optional vector store usage, logging, pricing, and A/B/QA/C pipeline primitives.",
    "The app can execute external processes on Windows (PowerShell, ssh/scp) and capture stdout/stderr deterministically.",
    "Remote Ubuntu host has: ssh server; bash; coreutils; and (for password-in-command Variant B) has sshpass installed or installable; the user understands this is less secure.",
    "Remote diagnostics should be runnable with either a privileged account or sudo-capable account; some data may be unavailable without root and must be marked accordingly.",
    "If OpenAI vector stores or file_search are not supported by the configured OpenAI account/runtime, the app must skip vector indexing and still upload to Files API.",
    "No new UI design requirements are introduced beyond wiring these diagnostics into existing Kája screens/flows (IN/OUT/DIAGNOSTICS)."
  ],
  "requirements": {
    "functional": [
      "Add Ubuntu SSH diagnostics capture (28.x) using PowerShell one-liner Variant B with password supplied inline (less secure): for ssh and scp use `sshpass -p $pw` and set `-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no`.",
      "Ubuntu remote collection must run a bash script that creates a `$remote_root` directory with `Diag_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS` naming and always `mkdir -p` all required subfolders.",
      "Ubuntu remote script must capture all command stdout+stderr into files; each artifact file must exist even when subsystem is missing; missing subsystems must be explicitly labeled with content `NOT PRESENT` (or a structured equivalent line containing NOT PRESENT).",
      "Ubuntu remote must always create and populate these folders/artifacts (at minimum with NOT PRESENT): firewall/nft_ruleset.txt; users_permissions/users_groups.txt, sudoers_listing.txt, umask.txt; processes_services/process_list.txt, services_state.txt, startup_items.txt; packages/dpkg_list.txt, apt_policy_key_pkgs.txt (nginx/openssl/python3/certbot/postgresql/redis), snap_list.txt; web/web_root_overview.txt, static_assets_sizes.csv, web_server_headers_hint.txt (curl -I http://127.0.0.1 tolerant, `|| true`); nginx/nginx_version.txt, nginx_test.txt, nginx_conf_tree.txt; app/app_dirs_overview.txt, systemd_units_related.txt (grep gunicorn/uvicorn/celery/worker), app_env_files_found.txt (listing/metadata only); python/where_python.txt, py_launcher_list.txt (pip versions), interpreters_inventory.csv (python3 sys.executable + sys.path as JSON); database/postgres_version.txt, postgres_service_status.txt, postgres_conf_locations.txt; certs/cert_locations.txt (find *.pem/*.crt), certbot_status.txt, cert_expiry_report.txt (openssl x509 -enddate for /etc/letsencrypt/live/*/cert.pem); cron_webhooks/crontab_root.txt, crontab_users_listing.txt, system_cron_dirs_tree.txt; logs/journal_nginx_last500.txt, journal_app_last500.txt, journal_db_last500.txt, syslog_tail.txt, auth_log_tail.txt, kernel_log_tail.txt; virtualization_containers/docker_info.txt, docker_ps.txt, docker_compose_files_found.txt.",
      "Ubuntu remote script must end by printing exactly one line `REMOTE_ROOT=$remote_root` to stdout; local PowerShell must parse using `Select-String '^REMOTE_ROOT='` and then download the entire directory using `scp -r` (also via sshpass).",
      "Ubuntu diagnostics output must include MANIFEST.md and README with updated folder list including: nginx/, app/, python/, database/, certs/, cron_webhooks/, logs/, virtualization_containers/.",
      "Ubuntu README/MANIFEST must include a 'File Index' table with example entries: README_problem.md, system/journal_boot_errors.txt, network/ss_listen.txt, nginx/nginx_test.txt, python/venv_candidates_found.txt, python/venv_reports/venv_*__report.json, certs/cert_expiry_report.txt, logs/journal_nginx_last500.txt, logs/journal_app_last500.txt.",
      "Ubuntu MANIFEST/README notes must warn: redact secrets before sharing; logs may contain PII; share selectively.",
      "Ubuntu MANIFEST/README must include integrity summary fields: `Total files {{file_count}}`, `Total size {{total_size_human}}`, and optionally generate checksums/sha256.txt.",
      "Provide template 28.23 MANIFEST.md titled 'Diagnostic Manifest' with fields: timestamp_local, hostname, collector_user, is_root, os_pretty_name, kernel, uptime, output_root; purpose: 'Ubuntu web server diagnostic snapshot'; Folder Overview must include at least: system/, hardware/, storage/, network/, firewall/, users_permissions/, processes_services/, packages/, web/.",
      "Add FULL Windows Diagnostics (29) collector producing an output directory (NOT a ZIP) with root `Diag_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS/` and required files/folders: MANIFEST.md, README_problem.md, CHANGELOG_last_actions.txt, system/, registry/, filesystem/, hardware/, storage/, drivers/, processes_services/, network/, security/, python/, devtools/, virtualization/, wsl/, logs/.",
      "Windows MANIFEST.md must be auto-generated with: Generated at, Machine, User, PowerShell ver, Run as Administrator; Folder Overview; Files table (File/Description/Size); Notes: ACCESS DENIED implies admin needed; missing subsystems explicitly noted.",
      "Windows system/ must include: systeminfo.txt, os_build.txt, windows_updates_hotfixes.txt, timezone_locale.txt, uptime_boot.txt, power_settings.txt, group_policy_summary.html, run_context.txt; and env/PATH: env_machine.txt (HKLM parsed), env_user.txt (HKCU parsed), path_effective_process.txt (runtime PATH), path_diff_analysis.txt (diff Machine vs User vs Runtime).",
      "Windows registry/ must include: env_machine.reg, env_user.reg; Python registry exports: python_core_hklm.reg, python_core_hklm_wow6432.reg, python_core_hkcu.reg, pylauncher_hklm.reg, pylauncher_hkcu.reg; App Execution: app_paths_python_hklm.reg, app_paths_python_hkcu.reg, windowsapps_execution_aliases.txt; Associations: file_associations_python.reg; Software: uninstall_inventory.txt (Python/Conda/VC++ runtimes).",
      "Windows filesystem/ must include: python_executables_found.txt, python_install_dirs_tree.txt; venv: venv_candidates_found.txt, venv_tree_summaries/venv_<name>.txt; projects: project_requirements_found.txt; user data (no binary content, only tree/sizes): userprofile_tree_depth3.txt, userprofile_top_sizes.csv, appdata_roaming_tree_depth4.txt, appdata_local_tree_depth4.txt, appdata_locallow_tree_depth4.txt (if exists), appdata_top_sizes.csv, known_folders_locations.txt (Documents/Downloads/Desktop incl. redirects/OneDrive), onedrive_status_hint.txt.",
      "Windows python/ must include: where_python.txt, py_launcher_list.txt, interpreters_inventory.csv; default runtime: python_version_default.txt, pip_version_default.txt, pip_list_default.txt, pip_freeze_default.txt, pip_debug_default.txt, pip_config_all.txt; internals: python_sys_path.json, python_site_packages.txt, python_platform.json; venv reports: python/venv_reports/venv_<name>__report.json.",
      "Windows processes_services/ must include: process_list.txt, services_state.txt, startup_items.txt, scheduled_tasks_summary.txt.",
      "Windows network/ must include: ipconfig_all.txt, adapters_details.txt, dns_client_config.txt, hosts_file.txt, routes.txt, netstat_ano.txt, firewall_profiles.txt, firewall_rules_export.wfw, winhttp_proxy.txt, internet_proxy_user.txt, wifi_profiles.txt.",
      "Windows security/ must include: defender_status.txt, applocker_effective.txt, uac_settings.txt, certificates_machine_summary.txt.",
      "Windows hardware/ must include: cpu.txt, memory_modules.txt, memory_summary.txt, motherboard_bios.txt, gpu_adapters.txt, monitors_displays.txt.",
      "Windows storage/ must include: volumes.txt, mount_points.txt, smart_status.txt, disk_performance_counters.txt.",
      "Windows drivers/ must include: driverquery_verbose.txt, pnp_devices.txt, problem_devices.txt, signed_drivers.txt.",
      "Windows devtools/ must include: git_version.txt, node_version.txt, dotnet_info.txt, vcpp_runtimes.txt.",
      "Windows virtualization/ must include: hyperv_state.txt, virtual_machine_platform.txt, windows_features.txt.",
      "Windows wsl/ must include: wsl_status.txt, wsl_list_verbose.txt, wsl_versions.txt.",
      "Windows logs/ must include: eventlog_system_last200.txt, eventlog_application_last200.txt, eventlog_security_last50.txt, wer_crash_list.txt, reliability_monitor_summary.txt, windows_setup_logs_hint.txt.",
      "Global diagnostics rules: never export secrets (tokens/passwords/private keys); for sensitive configs only metadata/masking; all produced artifacts must be uploaded to OpenAI Files API and recorded in manifests; optionally index into vector store with attributes {source=diagnostics, scope, captured_at} only if supported."
    ],
    "non_functional": [
      "Deterministic artifact naming and folder structure; always create the full expected folder tree and files.",
      "Robust logging: for each command executed (local or remote), log start/end timestamps, exit code, duration, and output file paths; do not log secrets (e.g., SSH password).",
      "Resilience: partial failures must not abort entire capture; missing subsystems must produce NOT PRESENT artifacts and continue.",
      "Performance: avoid expensive recursive scans beyond specified depth/targets; prefer summary outputs (trees, sizes, inventories).",
      "Compatibility: Windows diagnostics must run on Windows 10/11; Ubuntu script must be POSIX bash compatible on common Ubuntu LTS.",
      "Auditable manifests: include file list with sizes; include optional sha256 checksums for integrity without exposing secrets."
    ],
    "constraints": [
      "No external files in the planning/implementation process beyond the application’s own repository outputs; all scripts/templates must be generated by the app at runtime or embedded as resources.",
      "Ubuntu SSH Variant B must use sshpass with password in command invocation; must set StrictHostKeyChecking=no.",
      "Remote Ubuntu script must not collect secrets; must avoid printing secret contents; for env files and sensitive locations only list metadata/paths (no file contents).",
      "Windows FULL diagnostics output must be a directory with files, not a ZIP archive.",
      "Vector store + file_search must be used only if supported; otherwise only Files API upload is required."
    ]
  },
  "architecture": {
    "modules": [
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
        "responsibility": "Defines shared, deterministic data contracts for diagnostics runs, artifacts, manifests, and upload/indexing metadata across Ubuntu SSH and FULL Windows diagnostics.",
        "exports": [
          "record DiagnosticsRunSpec(string RunId, string Scope, DateTimeOffset CapturedAt, string OutputRoot, bool IncludeChecksums, bool UploadToFilesApi, bool TryIndexToVectorStore)",
          "record ArtifactSpec(string RelativePath, string Description, ArtifactKind Kind, ArtifactPresencePolicy PresencePolicy)",
          "enum ArtifactKind { Text, Csv, Json, Html, Reg, Binary }",
          "enum ArtifactPresencePolicy { MustExistWithNotPresentFallback, BestEffort }",
          "record CommandResult(int ExitCode, TimeSpan Duration, string StdoutPath, string StderrPath, string CombinedPath, string Notes)",
          "record ManifestFileEntry(string File, string Description, long SizeBytes)",
          "record FilesApiUploadRecord(string RelativePath, string OpenAiFileId, long SizeBytes, string Sha256)",
          "record VectorIndexRecord(string RelativePath, string VectorStoreFileId, Dictionary<string,string> Attributes)"
        ],
        "dependencies": []
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.Execution.ProcessRunner",
        "responsibility": "Runs local processes (PowerShell/ssh/scp/tools), captures stdout/stderr to files, redacts secrets from logs, and returns structured results.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IProcessRunner { Task<CommandResult> RunAsync(ProcessRunSpec spec, CancellationToken ct); }",
          "record ProcessRunSpec(string FileName, string Arguments, string WorkingDirectory, Dictionary<string,string> Environment, string StdoutFile, string StderrFile, string CombinedFile, TimeSpan Timeout, bool CreateNoWindow)",
          "static class ProcessRunnerFactory { static IProcessRunner CreateDefault(ILog log, IRedactionPolicy redaction); }"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
          "Logging.Core",
          "Security.Redaction"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Security.Redaction",
        "responsibility": "Defines rules and utilities to avoid collecting/logging secrets; provides masking for known secret patterns and disallows content collection for sensitive files.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IRedactionPolicy { string RedactLogText(string input); bool IsSensitivePath(string path); }",
          "sealed class DefaultRedactionPolicy : IRedactionPolicy",
          "static class SensitiveContentGuards { static bool ShouldOnlyListMetadata(string filePath); }",
          "static class NotPresentWriter { static void WriteNotPresent(string filePath, string reason); }"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.Manifest",
        "responsibility": "Generates MANIFEST.md / README templates and fills them with run metadata, folder overview, file index, integrity summary, and upload references.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IManifestGenerator { Task GenerateAsync(ManifestSpec spec, CancellationToken ct); }",
          "record ManifestSpec(string OutputRoot, string Title, Dictionary<string,string> HeaderFields, IReadOnlyList<string> FolderOverview, IReadOnlyList<ManifestFileEntry> FileEntries, IReadOnlyList<string> Notes, IntegritySummarySpec Integrity, IReadOnlyList<FilesApiUploadRecord> UploadRecords, IReadOnlyList<VectorIndexRecord> VectorRecords)",
          "record IntegritySummarySpec(int FileCount, string TotalSizeHuman, bool IncludeChecksums, string? ChecksumsRelativePath)"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
          "Security.Redaction"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.Integrity",
        "responsibility": "Counts files, totals sizes, optionally generates checksums/sha256.txt for an output root, and provides human-readable size formatting.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IIntegrityService { Task<IntegrityComputationResult> ComputeAsync(string outputRoot, bool includeChecksums, CancellationToken ct); }",
          "record IntegrityComputationResult(int FileCount, long TotalSizeBytes, string TotalSizeHuman, string? ChecksumsFilePath)"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.Upload.OpenAIFiles",
        "responsibility": "Uploads artifacts to OpenAI Files API, tracks returned file IDs, and provides manifest-ready upload records.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IFilesUploader { Task<IReadOnlyList<FilesApiUploadRecord>> UploadDirectoryAsync(string outputRoot, UploadSpec spec, CancellationToken ct); }",
          "record UploadSpec(string Purpose, bool IncludeChecksumsFile, IReadOnlyList<string> ExcludeGlobs)"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
          "OpenAI.Client",
          "Security.Redaction",
          "Logging.Core"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.Indexing.VectorStore",
        "responsibility": "Optionally adds uploaded files to a vector store with attributes; must detect support and no-op safely when unsupported.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IVectorIndexer { Task<VectorIndexOutcome> TryIndexAsync(VectorIndexSpec spec, CancellationToken ct); }",
          "record VectorIndexSpec(string VectorStoreId, IReadOnlyList<FilesApiUploadRecord> Files, Dictionary<string,string> BaseAttributes)",
          "record VectorIndexOutcome(bool Supported, IReadOnlyList<VectorIndexRecord> Records, string? Note)"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
          "OpenAI.Client",
          "Logging.Core"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.UbuntuSsh.RemoteScript",
        "responsibility": "Builds the bash script content for Ubuntu web server diagnostics per 28.x, enforcing folder creation, stdout+stderr capture to files, NOT PRESENT fallbacks, and no secrets collection.",
        "exports": [
          "interface IUbuntuRemoteScriptBuilder { string Build(UbuntuScriptSpec spec); }",
          "record UbuntuScriptSpec(string RemoteRootPrefix, string RunId, bool IncludeChecksums)"
        ],
        "dependencies": [
          "Diagnostics.DomainModels",
          "Security.Redaction"
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Diagnostics.UbuntuSsh.Collector",
        "responsibility": "Implements Ubuntu SSH diagnostics capture: uploads and executes remote bash script via sshpass+ssh, parses REMOTE_ROOT, downloads via sshpass+scp -r, then generates MANIFEST/README and uploads artifacts.",
        "exports": [
